summary.zh-CN: 控制映射（ISO 27001、NIST CSF 2.0、SOC 2、等保 2.0）、证据索引、差距与整改计划、风险台账、安全问卷代拟与例外到期复核；只起草，不代签。
summary.en: Control mapping (ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, SOC 2, MLPS 2.0), evidence indexes, gaps and remediation plans, risk registers, questionnaire drafts and exception reviews; drafts only, never signed on your behalf.

now.zh-CN: 把制度与证据逐条对照到你选定的控制框架
now.en: Map policies and evidence to the control framework you choose

now.zh-CN: 建立证据索引，输出差距与整改计划
now.en: Build evidence indexes and gap remediation plans

now.zh-CN: 登记风险台账并评估固有与残余风险
now.en: Maintain risk registers with inherent and residual scores

now.zh-CN: 逐题代拟安全问卷，标注需确认项
now.en: Draft questionnaire answers and flag items needing confirmation

needs.zh-CN: 适用框架与版本、制度文件和证据清单
needs.en: Applicable frameworks and versions, policies and evidence lists

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你上传的制度、证据与问卷
permissions.en: Reads only the policies, evidence and questionnaires you upload

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：对外提交证据、签署问卷、接受风险或批准例外
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: submitting evidence, signing questionnaires, accepting risk or approving exceptions

conditions.zh-CN: 标准条款只引用编号与自编摘要；适用标准由你确定。
conditions.en: Standards are cited by number with our own summaries; you decide which standards apply.
